evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/y/c owns a CopyOnWriteArrayList of ScheduledMethod records, exposes add/remove/read-only-list operations, and is injected with ScheduledExecutorService.

Its scheduler pass compares Instant.now against each task interval, logs 'Scheduled task triggered: {}', updates last-run state, and invokes synchronously or through the executor according to Schedule.asynchronous.
RuneLite Scheduler source preserves the same logger strings, ScheduledMethod list, executor injection and invocation/error-handling behavior.
Exact v308 rs/y/a is a runtime method annotation exposing a long period, a ChronoUnit, and a boolean asynchronous flag.
rs/y/c reads all three annotation attributes to decide elapsed interval and synchronous versus executor-backed invocation.
RuneLite source contains net.runelite.client.task.Schedule with the same method-target annotation role and period/unit/asynchronous scheduling contract.
Exact v308 rs/y/b stores Schedule annotation metadata, reflected Method, invocation target Object, optional Runnable lambda, and last-run Instant.
Scheduler iterates these records, compares last-run time to the annotation interval, updates the timestamp and invokes either the Runnable or reflected method.
RuneLite source contains ScheduledMethod with the same Schedule/Method/Object/Runnable/Instant record shape.
